page.heading: Branding
page.description: Product identity used across the admin panel, shop, e-mails and certificates.

reloadPrompt.message: Branding settings were saved. Reload the panel to see the changes.

descriptions.title: The product name shown in the browser tab title of the admin panel and the shop. Injected as the product name in the subject and body of transactional e-mails (e.g. "Your [Title] licence is ready") and printed as the product name on the licence certificate PDF.
descriptions.logoUrl: Full URL to the logo image (e.g. a PNG/SVG hosted externally). Shown in the admin panel sidebar and login screen, the shop header, the header of transactional e-mails (140px wide), and the header of the licence certificate PDF. If left empty, the admin panel and shop fall back to the built-in default logo.
descriptions.websiteUrl: The product's website address. Appears as a clickable link on the licence certificate PDF, both next to the logo and in the row describing how to download the software. Not currently used anywhere else.
descriptions.faviconUrl: URL of the icon shown in the browser tab (favicon) for the admin panel and the customer shop. If left empty, the browser falls back to the server's default icon.
descriptions.supportEmail: Support contact e-mail address, shown as a mailto link on the admin panel login screen and passed to the shop as its support contact. Also used as the seller's contact on order confirmation/invoice e-mails.
descriptions.primaryColor: Brand accent colour as a HEX value (e.g. #f59e0b). Sets the --color-primary CSS variable that drives button and active-navigation colours in the admin panel and shop, and is also used as the accent colour in transactional e-mails — the bar under the header and button backgrounds.
